one_line: Prithviraj Chauhan’s brother who briefly retook Ajmer after Tarain and resisted the early Ghurid advance.

appearance.age_look: Early 30s, athletic, medium broad shoulders with a seasoned warrior’s build.
appearance.face: Oval face with a straight nose, sharp jawline, wheatish North Indian complexion, neatly trimmed moustache and short beard, calm but intense eyes with a default expression of focused resolve.
appearance.hair: Thick, straight dark brown hair reaching just below the ears, parted slightly off-center and kept tidy; a narrow maroon cloth pagri (turban band) wrapped low around the head with its tail tucked at the back, a small gold tikka ornament at the forehead.
appearance.costume: Long-sleeved quilted cotton angarkha-style coat in muted dusty blue falling to mid-thigh, tied at the right side with maroon fabric cords; beneath it a cream-colored cotton tunic and fitted churidar-style trousers; a deep maroon woolen patka (waist sash) wrapped twice around the waist with the knotted end hanging on his left hip, subtly patterned with small gold chevron motifs; over the angarkha a fitted dull-steel chainmail vest covering torso and shoulders, secured at the front; a simple leather belt over the patka holding a sheath; soft brown leather mojari shoes with upturned toes; minimal jewelry—small gold stud earrings and a slender gold kara (bracelet) on his right wrist.
appearance.signature: A single straight-edged talwar-like sword with a slightly curved, polished steel blade, traditional Indo-Afghan hilt with a disc pommel and crossguard in dull gold tone, carried sheathed at his left hip in a plain brown leather scabbard with subtle maroon stitching.

ref_desc: Hariraja of Sapadalaksha is a wheatish-complexioned, early-thirties warrior with an oval face, short dark brown hair and maroon pagri band, wearing a dusty blue angarkha over cream garments, maroon sash, chainmail vest, brown mojari shoes, and carrying a talwar-like sword in a brown scabbard, in a palette of dusty blue, maroon, cream, brown leather and dull steel.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character turnaround of Hariraja of Sapadalaksha: an early-thirties North Indian Rajput warrior with an oval face, wheatish complexion, neatly trimmed moustache and short beard, and calm intense eyes. His hair is short, straight dark brown, parted slightly off-center and reaching just below the ears, with a narrow maroon cloth pagri band wrapped low around his head and a small gold tikka ornament at the forehead. He wears a long-sleeved dusty blue quilted angarkha-style coat to mid-thigh, tied at the right side with maroon cords, over a cream cotton tunic and fitted cream churidar-style trousers. Around his waist is a deep maroon woolen patka (waist sash) wrapped twice, knotted on the left hip with a hanging end, subtly patterned with small gold chevron motifs, and over this a simple leather belt that secures a plain brown leather scabbard. Over his torso and shoulders sits a fitted dull-steel chainmail vest, and on his feet are soft brown leather mojari shoes with slightly upturned toes. He wears minimal jewelry: small gold stud earrings and a thin gold bracelet on his right wrist. His signature weapon, a straight-edged talwar-like sword with a slightly curved polished steel blade and a traditional disc-pommel hilt in a dull gold tone, rests sheathed at his left hip. Show him from front, side, and back, keeping all colors consistent—dusty blue, maroon, cream, brown leather, and dull steel—and emphasize a dignified, historically grounded Rajput warrior presence suitable for late 12th-century Ajmer and Delhi.
